task: A select-based TCP echo server (no asyncio, no threading in the server) with a connection limit, and its test.

criteria.text: The server uses select (or selectors) over a listening socket and client sockets, with no asyncio and no threads in the server, on a configurable port, and serves several clients concurrently.
Echoes every complete line back to the client that sent it, newline included, buffering partial lines per client until the newline arrives.
On disconnect (recv returns b'' or a connection error) the socket is removed from the select sets, its buffer dropped and the socket closed.
At most 64 simultaneous clients: a 65th connection gets a rejection message and is closed.

The test starts the server (in a thread or process; the test may use them), connects 3 clients concurrently, sends different messages, checks each echo, disconnects them and checks the server cleaned up.

reference: Classic select loop: readable = select(inputs, [], []); accept on the listener (reject when 64 clients); recv per client into a buffer; send back each full line; on b'' remove and close.
